summary: In 2019 eBay's corporate security team, egged on by executives angered by mild critical coverage, stalked and terrorized Ina and David Steiner, a Massachusetts couple who ran the trade news site EcommerceBytes.

evidence.note: Steiners launch their eBay-focused news site in 1999
Wenig introduced: born 1966 in Brooklyn, career before eBay
background segment on HBGary and the corporate private-intelligence industry
Elliott Management stake puts executives under pressure over waste
security director Baugh enters; his CIA background follows
June 2019: contractor surveils the Steiners' home near Boston, harassment begins
Natick detective traces pizza payment to a card bought near eBay HQ
message deletions; Wenig implicated, resigns with large exit package
guilty pleas, prison sentences and eBay's 3 million dollar payment
Steiners' civil suit still ongoing; Wenig's later board seats

notes: Primary is eBay because the host frames the whole C-suite as the bastard, so roles are empty. Transcript renders Baugh as Bog/Baw, Wymer as Weimer, Cooke as Cook; standard spellings used. HBGary and Black Cube are context, not covered years. Wenig's pre-eBay career is brief, so covered_span starts at the 1999 site launch. End 2024 is eBay's 3M payment (DPA, January 2024).
